title: Post-Hoc Feature Attribution Specification for MoS2 Contacts

methods.name: TreeSHAP
strengths: Exact polynomial-time computation without sampling approximations
Satisfies efficiency axiom: sum of attributions exactly equals f(x) - E[f(X)]
methods.role: Primary explainer for tree ensembles in Section 5

methods.name: KernelSHAP
methods.algorithm: Weighted linear surrogate regression over coalitional subsets
strengths: Agnostic to model architecture; seamlessly explains Gaussian Processes and SVR
methods.role: Primary explainer for Bayesian GPR and kernel models

methods.name: Permutation_Feature_Importance
methods.algorithm: Out-of-fold feature shuffling measuring Delta RMSE
strengths: Non-parametric and robust on small-N validation splits
methods.role: Validation metric degradation benchmark across folds

methods.name: Partial_Dependence_PDP
strengths: Visually traces non-linear saturation curves (e.g. gate accumulation plateaus)
Forms the mathematical engine for the 2D Interpretable Regime Map
methods.role: Engine for 2D/3D Regime Mapping in Sprint 5.c

selected_primary_pair.local_attribution: SHAP (TreeSHAP for Ensembles, KernelSHAP for GPR)
